ns2:course.label: Advanced Financial Reporting
ns2:course.description: Current authoritative accounting standards and applications to accounting practice. Topics do not represent the full range of financial reporting issues, but are selected based on relevance of the underlying business transaction, complexity of the topic, consistency of applicable standard with underlying reporting concepts, and transferability of the standard to other accounting issues. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ACCY 303 or consent of department.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ACCY 303 or consent of department.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Restricted to BS:ACE - Agri-Accounting -UIUC, BS:Accountancy -UIUC, BS:Finance -UIUC, BS: Inf Sys & Info Tech -UIUC, BS: Supply Chain Mgmt -UIUC, BS: Business Process Mgt -UIUC, or BS: Management -UIUC.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Not intended for BS/MS Accy 3+2 Pgm students.
